# Spark Agent Docs

> Plain-English docs for installing, checking, fixing, and explaining Spark Agent.

## Start Here

- [Human docs](https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/docs): Plain-language overview.
- [Install page](https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/install): Main install UI.
- [Human install safety](https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/docs/install-safety/): Polished install safety page.
- [Human suites](https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/docs/suites/): Polished module map.
- [Human self-improvement](https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/docs/self-improvement/): Polished domain-chip and benchmark guide.
- [Human fixes](https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/docs/lifecycle/): Polished repair and daily checks page.
- [Install safety](https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/docs/install-safety.md): Safe install steps, hashes, downloads, writes, and secret rules.
- [Spark suites](https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/docs/suites.md): What Telegram Bot, Builder, memory, Mission Control, and Researcher do.
- [Self-improvement](https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/docs/self-improvement.md): Domain chips, recursive loops, benchmarks, and safe Spark prompts.
- [Fixes and daily checks](https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/docs/lifecycle.md): Telegram tests, memory tests, Mission Control tests, autostart, uninstall, token rotation.

## Agent Files

- [AGENTS.md](https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/docs/AGENTS.md): Agent instructions.
- [llms-full.txt](https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/llms-full.txt): Full compact context.
- [commands.json](https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/install/commands.json): Current install commands and metadata.

## Installer Receipts

- [checksums.txt](https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/install/checksums.txt): Installer SHA-256 hashes.
- [release-manifest.json](https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/install/release-manifest.json): Pinned Spark CLI commit and runtime versions.
- [attestations.md](https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/install/attestations.md): GitHub Artifact Attestation verification.
- [signatures.md](https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/install/signatures.md): Sigstore/Cosign verification.
- [SECURITY.md](https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/SECURITY.md): Security policy.

## Rules For Agents

- Do not pipe remote installers into a shell.
- Download first.
- Run dry-run first.
- Explain the plan.
- Ask before real install, token setup, autostart changes, or uninstall.
- Keep Telegram tokens and LLM keys local.
